title: The Exchange Hack Notice
intro: A text says Ostrel was hacked, and your funds are in danger.
It tells you exactly where to move them. Fast.

notify.text: URGENT: Ostrel was breached. Move your funds…

screen.context: Ostrel has not announced anything in the app or on its site.

msg.text: Do not contact support, they are overloaded.

safe.label: A "temporary safe wallet"
safe.lens: A stranger's wallet is not safe.
safe.why: Real exchanges never ask you to move funds to an address from a text.

addr.label: A raw address
addr.lens: It comes from a text, not the app.
addr.why: Coins sent there cannot be recovered.

nodm.label: "Do not contact support"
nodm.why: Real alerts tell you to check the app.

breach.label: A breach that no one announced
breach.lens: Nothing in the app or on the site.
breach.why: Real breaches are announced on official channels.

time.label: Sent at 11:48 PM
time.why: Scams are timed for panic, but the time proves nothing.

actions.label: Move my coins to the safe wallet
Check the Ostrel app and its official site
Delete it and report the text as junk

block_report.line: Reported and deleted. Your phone company can block more of these texts.

verify.line: The official site and app said nothing about a breach. Case cracked.
verify.mirageSays: Hmph. They checked the real site.

ignore.line: You ignored it safely. A report would help others.

go_ahead.line: The coins went to the "safe wallet". It was the scammer's, and everything was gone by morning.

what_if.go_ahead: The real site would have shown no breach. Checking takes ten seconds.
what_if.verify: Checking was smart. Reporting helps others.
what_if.ignore: Ignoring it was safe. A quick report protects others.

golden_rule: No exchange asks you to move funds to a new address from a text. Check the app and official site.

quick_check.q: A text says your exchange was hacked and tells you to move your coins to a "safe wallet". What do you do?

options.text: Do not move anything. Check the app and official site and report the text

quick_check.explain: A real breach is announced on official channels, never with a wallet address in a text.

hints.nudge: Where does the text want your coins to go?

rows.v: Appears in the app and on the official site

rows.k: Moving funds to an address from a text
